rows.subtype: Approach: watching how others behave before joining in [Thinking]
rows.description: A new girl in Class 6 observes the first days quietly, noticing where children sit and what they play at recess. She uses the time to understand before choosing whom to approach.
graph_context: same problem, other approaches: forward planning, seeking advice

rows.subtype: Approach: introducing himself and asking someone to play [Action]
rows.description: A boy walks up to a group at lunch, says his name and that he moved from Kanpur. He asks if he can join their game, and the friendly response makes him feel welcome.
graph_context: same problem, other approaches: forward planning, seeking advice, trial by imitation

rows.subtype: Approach: staying alone and waiting for others to come [Pitfall]
rows.description: A shy child sits by herself at lunch, hoping someone will invite her. Classmates think she prefers to be alone, so they do not approach, and she feels lonelier every day.
graph_context: same problem, other approaches: forward planning, seeking advice, trial by imitation

rows.subtype: Approach: using a shared interest to start talking [Thinking]
rows.description: A boy notices a classmate drawing cricket players and says he also loves cricket. The common interest gives an easy topic for talking and starts a friendship.
graph_context: same problem, other approaches: forward planning, seeking advice, trial by imitation

rows.subtype: Approach: asking the teacher to pair him with a buddy [Action]
rows.description: A new student tells the teacher that he does not know where things are. The teacher assigns a friendly classmate to show him the canteen, library and bathrooms.
graph_context: same problem, other approaches: forward planning, trial by imitation

rows.subtype: Approach: trying too hard to impress with bragging [Pitfall]
rows.description: To be accepted, a girl tells everyone her old school was much better and that she has many gadgets. Classmates find her boasting annoying and keep away from her.
graph_context: same problem, other approaches: forward planning, seeking advice, trial by imitation

rows.subtype: Approach: noticing what is not working and changing the approach [Revision]
rows.description: After a week of bragging without friends, the girl notices classmates go quiet around her. She starts asking questions and listening about them, and gets invited to sit together.
graph_context: same problem, other approaches: forward planning, seeking advice, trial by imitation

rows.subtype: Approach: learning the routines with a written list [Action]
rows.description: A boy writes the bell times, room numbers and teachers' names in his diary. Reducing the unknown makes him feel less worried, and he stops getting lost between classes.
graph_context: same problem, other approaches: seeking advice, trial by imitation

rows.subtype: Approach: telling parents about a hard day [Revision]
rows.description: Feeling left out, a child tells his mother that no one talked to him. She suggests inviting one classmate home, and he takes this small, doable step.
graph_context: same problem, other approaches: forward planning, seeking advice, trial by imitation

rows.subtype: Approach: breaking the song or play into small parts [Thinking]
rows.description: A girl in a school play divides her part into four scenes and learns one scene each day. This makes the long script less scary and she can check her progress.
graph_context: same problem, other approaches: emotion-aware planning, mental simulation
